## Scope of this change

Describe whether this affects normative wording, translation, guides, interface mapping, or an example.

## Correspondence and acceptance criteria

Identify changed use cases or criteria, or state that none are affected.

## Derivation and interaction mapping

Name affected source and destination baselines, the accountable person, and any ADIB element-to-case links.

## Verification actually performed

Include commands and results, with environment. Do not claim runs not performed.

## Versioning and attribution

Identify whether the change is editorial or requires a new normative edition.
